title: Power BI Dataflows Error-Rate Trend Anomaly
app: Power BI dataflow refresh events from the M365/Purview audit log and Admin API via HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:dataflow
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count as events, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as errors by _time
| eval error_rate=round(100*errors/events,2)
| eventstats avg(error_rate) as avg_rate, stdev(error_rate) as sd_rate
| where error_rate>avg_rate+3*sd_rate
| sort - _time
description: Baselines the hourly error rate for Power BI Dataflows and flags hours where it spikes more than three standard deviations above normal, catching emerging instability before it becomes an outage.
value: An error-rate spike is the earliest signal that Power BI Dataflows is degrading; statistical baselining suppresses routine noise and pages only on genuine anomalies.
implementation: Ingest Power BI Dataflows logs into index=bi; schedule every 15 minutes over a trailing window and alert on 3-sigma error-rate anomalies.
visualization: Timechart of Power BI Dataflows error rate with anomaly band.
grandmaExplanation: We learn what a normal amount of Power BI Dataflows errors looks like and warn you only when something is genuinely going wrong.
